code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    line = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 2 for v in row))
    bg = Counter(v for r, row in enumerate(grid) if r != line for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) if r != line for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    side = -1 if r1 < line else 1
    height = r1-r0+1
    new_r0 = line-height if side < 0 else line+1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, c in cells:
        out[r][c] = bg
    for r, c in cells:
        out[new_r0+(r-r0)][c] = grid[r][c]
    mark = new_r0-1 if side < 0 else new_r0+height
    if 0 <= mark < h:
        out[mark] = [8]*w
    return out
'''
